S01.evidence: his sexual desire improved after discontinuing Semaglutide

S02.why: New patient with visual disturbance the authors link to semaglutide as possible cause.

S03.evidence: experienced transient intestinal ischemia following his first Wegovy dosage
S03.why: New patient with intestinal ischemia attributed to semaglutide.

S04.evidence: suggesting that metformin was the most likely causative agent
S04.why: New patient with erythema multiforme assessed as probably caused by metformin.

S06.evidence: semaglutide-induced gastroparesis and slow intestinal transit may have contributed to bezoar formation

S11.evidence: severe acidemia due to MILA precipitated by post-obstructive acute kidney injury

S15.evidence: severe AKI while on metformin therapy
S15.why: New patient with MALA linked to metformin accumulation.

S16.evidence: confirmed the diagnosis of metformin-associated encephalopathy

S20.evidence: sequential unilateral TOH episodes, temporally related to semaglutide exposure and re-exposure
